record.question: When a person is a victim of an offence under IPC and such offence is also a tort, eg in the case of defamation, negligence, nuisance etc. such person has a remedy available through:
options: Civil suit, for compensation under law of torts only
Criminal case, for fixing the criminal liability on the accused under IPC only
record.explanation: A wrong that is both a crime and a tort leaves the victim with cumulative remedies—a civil tort suit for compensation and a criminal case under the IPC—since the two proceedings serve different purposes.
